events.title: Solitaire & Cheats Launches November 16, 2026
events.summary: Solitaire & Cheats launches on Steam on November 16, 2026!Settle into a cozy late-night jazz club for classic Klondike with a useful twist: the points you earn can pay for cheats when a deal gets difficult.Keep your score, or spend it on a way forward. Every shortcut has a price.The full game lets you:Choose your rules, shaping the difficulty from Chill to Fun to Nightmare.Share game codes to challenge friends on the same deal, and revisit your games through replays.Draw or import your own card

events.title: Solitaire & Cheats: Free Demo Now Available
events.summary: The free Solitaire & Cheats demo is now playable on Steam. Classic Klondike. One useful twist: the points you earn can pay for cheats when a deal gets difficult. Keep your score, or spend it on a way out. Your move. Play the free demo from the Solitaire & Cheats Steam page: About the demo: card-art editing, Steam Workshop, custom difficulty, game-code loading, achievements, and replays are reserved for the full game and are not included in this demo. Thanks for playing,
